name: Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG
summary: Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG's activities primarily span the automotive industry and financial services. The company is responsible for the design, production, and global distribution of vehicles, complemented by a range of associated services. Furthermore, it delivers diverse financial solutions, such as financing for both customers and dealerships, leasing programs, and various mobility-related offerings. Porsche also markets branded accessories and fashion products. Initially known as Porsche Fünfte Vermögensverwaltung AG, the firm changed its name to Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG in November 2009. Established in 2009, its headquarters are located in Stuttgart, Germany. Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG functions as a subsidiary of Porsche Holding Stuttgart GmbH.
